update_message.en: A new version of Time to Rogue is available.

news.title: Play on iPhone and Apple Watch
news.message: Time to Rogue is playable on iPhone and Apple Watch. Continue the same run on either device, then check your Focus from the iPhone widget or Watch complication.

tips: Movement, attacks, and waiting spend Focus. Using an item does not.
Focus is your field of view. Let real-world time pass to see farther again.
The dungeon waits while Focus recovers, then starts taking turns while you are away.
Finding the stairs quickly keeps the rising danger behind you.
A time-reverse can undo a fatal move, if you still have one when it counts.
Your iPhone and paired Apple Watch continue the same run.
The iPhone widget and Watch complication show when you are ready to return.
